metric.covered: an address counts as covered when some export has a TARGET line for it, when some export names it as the containing function, or when it falls inside an exported RANGE

trampoline_cluster.note: The unresolved tail is confined to this region. Stubs of 0x1e..0x20 bytes alternate with 6-byte __gnu_thumb1_case_shi dispatchers and call each other, so exporting one always reveals the next: the tail is bounded by the region, not by the number of passes.
